cells.gaps: The Vice President listed business registration among the services on the CADIS app at its launch in October 2024, but in July 2026 Registrar-General officials said end-to-end online registration was still being piloted; the newer fact stands, so online registration in service is not established.
cells.note: Reassessed on the CADIS launch story: a newer source calls online registration a pilot, so the registration aspect stays under way and the stage stays 2.
